ui_bugs.issue: Stray `)}` renders as literal visible text inside the passport card (visible under 'Scorurile casei'/'Dezactivează pașaportul public'). Root cause: JSX conditional wrapper `{showPrivacy && (` was removed from line ~96 but the matching `)}` on line 108 was left behind. Consequences: (a) literal `)}` text bleeds into UI, (b) privacy checklist + 'Dezactivează pașaportul public' button are ALWAYS visible instead of toggling with passport-privacy-toggle (regression vs iteration_135 which noted 'passport-disable-btn is rendered only when privacy panel is open').

rca_of_the_issue: PassportCard.jsx L96-108: the JSX opening `{showPrivacy && (` was accidentally dropped in a recent edit but the matching `)}` on L108 was preserved. React renders bare `)}` as literal DOM text (only `{` and `<` are special in JSX), so the browser shows `)}` under the passport card. Simultaneously, without the conditional guard the entire privacy-list div (checkboxes + Dezactivează button) renders unconditionally, breaking the passport-privacy-toggle UX. Fix: wrap L96-107 with `{showPrivacy && (` prefix and keep `)}` on L108.
